summary: Senior EPC, operations, and techno-commercial sales leader with 27+ years of experience across infrastructure, utilities, water, wastewater, and industrial projects. Currently serving as Assistant Vice President - Sales & Marketing at Hydroflux Engineering Pvt. Ltd., leading client relationships, business development, proposal and BOQ finalization, negotiation support, and WTP/STP/ETP/ZLD solution selling backed by end-to-end EPC delivery expertise.

highlights: Led techno-commercial sales for WTP, STP, ETP, and ZLD solutions, translating client requirements into technically aligned, commercially viable offerings.
Strengthened client relationships and business development through consultative meetings, site surveys, requirements discovery, and solution presentations.
Reviewed proposals and coordinated BOQ, scope, and specification finalization with engineering, estimation, and delivery teams.
Supported offer negotiations and order finalization by resolving technical-commercial clarifications and aligning scope and commercial terms.
Lead turnkey EPC delivery across civil, mechanical, electrical, and instrumentation scopes, from design validation and site execution through commissioning, client handover, and operations closure.
Direct multidisciplinary teams, consultants, vendors, client representatives, and local authorities to align approvals, execution, measurements, billing, and handover milestones.
Deliver STPs, ETPs, WTPs, RO/DM plants, pumping stations, drainage networks, industrial utilities, and public infrastructure across multi-location environments.
Strengthen project controls through scheduling, resource planning, milestone reviews, QA/QC, HSE compliance, MIS reporting, vendor follow-up, and stakeholder communication.
Apply CPWD, MES, and PSU process knowledge to tender compliance, RA billing, BOQ validation, budgeting, and commercial documentation while improving turnaround, cost control, and delivery discipline.
Progressed from senior site engineering assignments into project management, directing water and wastewater facilities for automotive, power, sugar, industrial, and institutional clients.
Executed civil, structural, MEP, and utility works while coordinating clients, consultants, contractors, vendors, and QA/QC inspectors against milestone plans.
Managed parallel facilities while maintaining design and regulatory compliance, safety discipline, QA/QC records, and commissioning readiness.
Controlled BOQs, RA billing, measurements, progress reports, site logs, vendor coordination, and handover support, contributing to early completion with a zero-safety-incident focus.
